purpose: canonical count and enumeration of fixture defects across the forward engineering arc, because a wrong number must not stand silently

CORRECTION.my_prose_said: 'fixture was itself at fault FOUR times', then enumerated A2/A3 3 + C 1 + D 1 = 5
CORRECTION.on_re-audit: the enumeration was ALSO wrong, in the other direction: A3 contributed one case I had not counted at all, and one of the three I attributed to A2/A3 was a resource defect, not a wrong-reason pass

CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.fixture: 'a refused write leaves the partition INCOMPLETE, not silently current'
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.why_wrong: the EXPECTATION was wrong. A rejected short write must not destroy validated prior data; the safe behaviour would have been scored a failure.
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.repair: added a run_id currency guard so the bytes stay COMPLETE but are NOT CURRENT for a new run; the suite grew 13 -> 15

CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.fixture: 'vbo live state not materialised -> HARD FAIL'
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.why_wrong: the fixture used state s=100 at window start 200 — 100 bars old, so the frozen engine kills it via i-s > BREAK before any lookup. No exception could ever fire.
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.repair: s=195, within BREAK of the window start; the guard then fired

CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.why_wrong: the fixture raised A3Hold FROM ITSELF and never called load_manifest. It proved nothing about the module.
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.found: during this bookkeeping re-audit, after A3 was already sealed PASS
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.repair: the fixture now writes a 68-feature manifest and calls the real guard
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.verification: re-run confirms the MODULE guard fires: 'GUARD feature_count: 68 != 69'. A3 fixtures remain 32/32.
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.why_A3_still_stands: the same guard was independently exercised by the extra-70th-feature fixture, which did call load_manifest. The guard was always sound; only this one fixture was hollow.

CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.fixture: 'DRY_RUN record appended with a production role -> CHold'
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.why_wrong: it hit GUARD no_genesis because the directory did not exist; it never reached the role guard
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.repair: relabelled to what it actually tests, and the DRY_RUN-into-PRODUCTION direction recorded as CODE-PATH INSPECTION ONLY, since exercising it live would require creating a production genesis

CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.fixture: 'a PRODUCTION runner cannot accept a DRY_RUN LOOK'
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.why_wrong: the expectation named DHold; the refusal correctly arrives as CHold from the ledger's chain-role layer, one layer EARLIER
CLASS_1_FIXTURE_PASSED_FOR_THE_WRONG_REA.repair: the fixture accepts either hold and names which one fired; the behaviour was right, the expectation too narrow

CLASS_2_HARNESS_RESOURCE_DEFECTS.defect: a whole-store 602M-row join exhausted 49 GiB of temp
CLASS_2_HARNESS_RESOURCE_DEFECTS.repair: the two-way EXCEPT ALL already IS the exhaustive per-column oracle; replaced with a bounded reconciliation

CLASS_2_HARNESS_RESOURCE_DEFECTS.defect: a duplicate-key scan over 602M rows OOM'd

not_in_either_class: the monolithic pd12 EXCEPT ALL that spilled 23 GB — that was a deliberate method change for disk safety, disclosed at the time, not a defect
PRODUCER_AND_WRAPPER_DEFECTS_FOUND_BY_FI: KeyError instead of A2Hold on a missing upstream column (pd12)
BIGINT emitted where the frozen table declares TINYINT (pd12)
completion decided by file readability alone (A2 partition authority)
a vbo live state outside the resumed window (PHASE1_R1) — drove the state-materialisation design
a resumed window silently assuming eprev=False (STAGE_D_R2)
_require() advancing the state machine on a REFUSED step (D)
observation: every one of these was found by a fixture, not by reading the code
LESSON: Guards and fixtures are part of the evidence system, not merely test infrastructure. A fixture that passes for the wrong reason is itself a defect and must be preserved as such rather than silently repaired.
